cover.prompt: Professional wide editorial cover for a Portuguese Flutter tic-tac-toe tutorial. Tactile paper-cut and subtle 3D shapes; a correct 3×3 board, exactly three teal X across the top row and two terracotta O in the middle row, other cells empty. Warm ivory background, charcoal board edges, soft light, spacious composition; abstract blue folded-paper programming accent. No people, text, code, watermark or UI mockup.
cover.alt: Ilustração conceitual de um tabuleiro 3 por 3: três X verdes vencem na primeira linha; dois O laranja ocupam a segunda linha.
